title: Mullvad plans to shut down its public DNS resolver; a free Proton VPN with DNS filtering alternative
content_md:
Mullvad has announced the planned shutdown of its public DNS resolver. The author, while looking for a free alternative to Mullvad VPN, wrote up a free VPN option with DNS filtering: Proton VPN with DoH/DoT over a WireGuard tunnel. (Translated from Polish.)

via Mastodon https://eteryu.space/blog/2026/10/09/darmowy-vpn-z-filtrowaniem-dns-proton-vpn--dohdot-przez-wg-tunnel/
exclude_reason: Social post about Mullvad DNS shutdown; not a security vulnerability or breach.
